# EXC003: defer-ticket-terminal

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | EXC |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | error |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| polarity | P+ |
| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A defer directive names a ticket that is done or dropped.

The debt's ticket reached a terminal category, so the exit condition of the
defer is met: pay the debt (remove the directive and fix the finding) or
re-point the defer at a live ticket. The deferred finding stays suppressed
and listed so the failure is this one finding, not a surprise.

## Examples

### EXC003 defer pointing at a terminal ticket / Fires when the ticket is done #1 (line 6) (fire)

```rust
/* frob:defer COV001 because="split after the parser lands" ticket={{DONE}} */ // error: EXC003
pub fn f() {}
```

### EXC003 defer pointing at a terminal ticket / Clean when the ticket is open #2 (line 13) (clean)

```rust
/* frob:defer COV001 because="split after the parser lands" ticket={{OPEN}} */
pub fn f() {}
```
